label: UniFi Cloud Gateway Max
description: Ubiquiti UCG-Max - compact fanless 2.5G cloud gateway with NVR: 5x 2.5GbE RJ45 (1 WAN + 4 LAN), no SFP cages.
notes:
Power: none of these copper ports accepts PoE. Vendor page https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ucg-max (HTTP 200, 668,564 B, read 2026-11-19, server-rendered tech-spec table) says "Power Method = USB type C (5V DC/5A)"; a box fed from mains, a USB-C supply or a DC jack has no PoE-PD front end, so WAN / Port 1 / Port 2 / Port 3 / Port 4 now declare poeIn: false. Without that declaration the engine's isPoePd() match on "unifi" gave each silent copper port a 12.95 W 802.3af draw - the defect PR #2118 and PR #2121 fixed across the UXG family (refs #130).

LAN bank is one bridge (measured 2026-11-20 23:5x UTC). `https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/cloud-gateways/ucg-max` (HTTP 200, 668,564 B, server-rendered spec table) prints **MAC Address Table Size = 2,000** in its Networking section beside `Port Layout - 2.5 GbE RJ45 = 5 (2.5G/1G/100M/10M)`, `Max. WAN Port Count = 4` and `Default WAN Ports (1) 2.5 GbE RJ45`; the storefront payload (`https://store.ui.com/us/en/category/cloud-gateways-compact/collections/cloud-gateway-max/products/ucg-max` - the address `/us/en/products/ucg-max` 307s to - HTTP 200, 646,522 B) carries the same 2,000 row. A 2,000-entry MAC table is a bridge FDB, and a box that only routed would hold none, so Port 1-Port 4 forward at layer 2 and the row declares `l2-forward`. Ubiquiti publishes no LACP and no 802.1Q row for this SKU on either surface, so the token is claimed for MAC learning only - which is the fact the vendor states. Without it `switchport access vlan` and `channel-group` were refused and two LAN hosts in one subnet could not ARP each other; `no switchport` still routes a port and the WAN port keeps its address.
